rhurricane-environment.label: Data Environment
rhurricane-environment.helpText: Production uses live data from the National Hurricane Center. Development uses test data.

summary-update-freq.label: Data Check Frequency (min)
summary-update-freq.helpText: How frequently to check for updates on the summary API.

summary-stale-hours.label: Data API Stale Time (hr)
summary-stale-hours.helpText: When to consider the summary API data to be outdated and not displayed.

automate-posts.label: Enable Post Automation
automate-posts.helpText: Whether to allow the app to automatically create a post. Either when there are significant changes, or (if enabled below) periodically when there are no new changes.

automate-repost-freq.label: Repost Freq (hr)
automate-repost-freq.helpText: How frequently to repost if no significant changes. Must be Six (6) or greater. Zero (0) disables this feature.

maintenance-mode.label: Maintenance Mode
maintenance-mode.helpText: Whether to enable or disable maintenance mode. Soft displays an announcement and the app is usable. Hard only displays the message and (X) icon.

maintenance-mode-message.label: Custom Maintenance Message
maintenance-mode-message.helpText: A message to display when maintenance is enabled.

log-level.label: Log Level
log-level.helpText: Controls the level of log messages for performance.

discord-noti-url.label: Discord Notification URL
discord-noti-url.helpText: A Discord channel webhook URL to send alerts to.

noti-silence.label: Notification Silence (min)
noti-silence.helpText: How long to silence the same notification sent to Discord.
